Migration's done. Moved 12 files off `db.query` onto `db.execute({ sql, params })` — sla, cohort, macroAdmin, refund, returnService, teamService, supplier, apiKeyAdmin, session, variantAdmin, shipment, and couponService.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone since it's vendored, and didn't touch the `cache.query` calls — different thing entirely. The verifier confirms every module still works and nothing else moved.
